Armarouge

Fire Psychic

Paldea · Generation 9

Armarouge is a Fire/Psychic-type Fire Warrior Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 85 kg. It evolves from Charcadet. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (125), with a base stat total of 525.
